resources.string: Applies the blocking rules set in Vesta Parent.

Vesta Tracker uses this service to detect which app is open and block the ones the administrator restricted in Vesta Parent. If the website filter is on, it also reads the address of the site open in the Brave browser to block domains that are not allowed and notify Vesta Parent. It does not read what is typed or anything else on the screen, and it is not used as an accessibility tool.
